name: engineering-memlog
description: Engineering memory for AI coding agents — a structured cross-project log, a deliberately dumb CLI, and a Claude Code plugin that closes the read-side loop with auto-firing hooks.

plugins.name: engineering-memlog
plugins.description: Auto-injects relevant prior lessons from the engineering log at session start (project-aware via manifest sniffing) and on symptom-shaped prompts (errors / failures / 4xx / 5xx / framework names). Hooks bypass LLM judgement to close the read-side loop. Includes a /recall slash command for explicit deep dives.
